notes:
SHARP AQUOS TVE21F (reported as AQUOS-TVE21F; device banqiao, product tcpreue_b), UK
Android TV 14 (SDK 34), firmware UKNV.260623.001, CVTE/MediaTek platform, 1.8 GB RAM
Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (already disabled when this list was applied)
Live TV app: com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter; HDMI/tuner inputs: com.mediatek.tvinput

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sharp-aquos-tve21f/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sharp-aquos-tve21f/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED for user 0, never uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Applied and verified on 2026-10-20: screenshots after each batch, Live TV, HDMI 1, Play Store and
SmartTube playback. Package names never say what they do on this firmware: every entry below was
checked with `dumpsys package` first.

Kept on purpose: Google Play Store + Play Services, Gboard, Google TTS, Dolby audio,
com.mediatek.tvinput / com.mediatek.tv.service / com.mediatek.wwtv.tvcenter (Live TV and HDMI),
com.mediatek.wwtv.setupwizard (channel scan), com.mediatek.wwtv.mediaplayer (USB media),
com.mediatek.tv.freeviewplay, com.cvte.hotkey.dispatcher (remote hotkeys),
com.cvte.automaticbrightnesscontrol, com.cvte.tv.kmode (picture mode), com.cvte.tv.infoprovider,
all com.cvte.overlay.* and com.mediatek.* overlays, com.mstar.android.tv.disclaimercustomization.
